description: Source code for a Flutter widget that displays a WebView loaded from local assets, with path sanitization, error handling, and resource existence checks.

classes.name: WebViewScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a WebView loaded from a specified asset path.

classes.name: _WebViewScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the WebView, asset loading, and error handling for WebViewScreen.

methods.name: _sanitizeStrict
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes the input path to a strict asset path under 'assets/', enforcing .html extension and preventing traversal.

methods.name: _prepareAndLoad
methods.description: Verifies asset existence, parses HTML references, checks resource availability, and loads content into the WebView controller based on platform.

methods.name: _extractTitle
methods.description: Extracts the <title> content from HTML to set as WebView page title.

methods.name: _findMissingReferences
methods.description: Parses HTML content to find referenced CSS, JS, images, and checks their existence, returning list of missing assets.
